summary: Keycloak error 'jwt.exceptions.InvalidAudienceError: Audience doesn't match' is fixed by adding an Audience mapper under Client scopes > <client>-dedicated with your client in Included Client Audience.
questions: How do I add an audience mapper in Keycloak for AAP?

answer_card.title: Keycloak: Audience doesn't match
answer_card.answer_md:
Error: `jwt.exceptions.InvalidAudienceError: Audience doesn't match`

In Keycloak: **Client scopes > YOUR-CLIENT-ID-dedicated > Add mapper > Audience**, name it, and select your client in *Included Client Audience*.
